content.value: The variables controlling the motion of a floating vessel through water are the drag force F, 12 the speed V, the length L, the density p , the dynamic viscosity µ of water and the gravitational acceleration g. Derive an expression for the drag force by dimensional analysis of Buckingham's rr-theorem.
